description: List family files, optionally narrowed to one folder, Latest uploads, or starred files. Each file carries its details (summary, dates, facts) and its folderPath. Files has **Latest uploads** (unfiled files: they land there, expire after a set number of days unless moved into a folder, and have a separate cap) and **folders** (kept files count toward the family's storage limit). Storage, Latest-uploads and per-file size caps apply; list_folders reports current usage. Private files and folders are never visible to assistants.

folderId.description: Only files directly in this folder (from list_folders)

inbox.description: true = only Latest uploads (unfiled); false = only files already kept in a folder

starred.description: true = only starred files; false = only unstarred files

name: list_files
title: List files
